title: Run Ledger
description: Groundwork run ledger — the orchestrator's session-scoped work record stored under .groundwork/runs/<session_id>.json (legacy: .groundwork/run.json).
$comment: ENFORCEMENT MODEL: Two-tier depending on command. (1) HARD at `init` (cmdInit calls checkLedgerStrict): schema violations are treated as hard errors — they throw with exitCode=1, so a schema-violating ledger can never be written at init time. (2) ADVISORY for all other mutations (complete, gate, set, add — these call the soft checkLedger): schema violations surface as warnings to stderr, the command succeeds with exit 0. Rationale: a running session must be able to drain its ledger even if an older schema version wrote something structurally non-conformant. The three hand-written HARD checks (exit 1, all commands): (1) blocked_by referential integrity — referenced ids must exist in slices[]; (2) acceptance array must be non-empty; (3) individual acceptance strings must be non-empty. Additional invariants the schema does NOT cover at all: (a) acceptance-criteria satisfaction — strings are free-form, not evaluated; (b) write_token secrecy — schema treats it as an opaque string; (c) slice id uniqueness — JSON Schema cannot assert uniqueness of non-primitive items across arrays.

session_id.description: UUID of the Claude Code session that owns this ledger.

active.description: False once the run is abandoned or the stop-gate releases the session.

goal.description: One-sentence description of the run's objective (preferred field; older ledgers used 'brief').

brief.description: Legacy alias for 'goal'. Accepted for back-compat.

plan_ref.description: Path (or null) to the plan file consulted for this run.

write_token.description: Opaque random token required for gate/complete mutations. Treated as a secret; never reproduced in logs.

reinforcements.description: Arbitrary extra context or annotations attached by the orchestrator.

progressSig.description: Opaque progress signal used by the stop-gate hook.

awaiting_human.description: When true, the stop-gate will not nag while the orchestrator is correctly paused awaiting a human decision. Set only via `ledger await-human --token <write_token>`. Cleared with --clear. Does NOT bypass the completion gate — releasing the hold resumes normal enforcement.

gate.description: Gate verdicts keyed by gate name (advisor, verifier, qa).

pacing.description: Optional session-pacing policy (D-28). Absent means pacing is disabled; existing ledgers without this field validate unchanged. Consumption (resolved units) is derived at runtime and adjusted by the stored offset.

policy.description: Unit of pacing. 'wave' counts completed waves; 'slice' counts completed non-exempt slices; 'milestone' gates on human-verified shippable deliverables (see milestone_artifacts and milestone_signoff).

budget.description: Number of units the session may start before pacing blocks further claims. 0 means no new units may be started without a grant.

exempt_kinds.description: Slice kinds that are always claimable and never counted against budget (e.g. orientation work: plan, diagnose, design, fog).

offset.description: Number of units already resolved in the seed ledger at init time. Subtracted from resolvedUnits so prior-session completions don't count against this session's budget (F14 fix).

grant.description: Temporary budget extension written by 'ledger autopilot'. Expires with the session.

range.description: Number of additional units granted on top of budget.

granted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the grant was issued.

granted_by.description: Identity that issued the grant (e.g. orchestrator session id or 'autopilot').

milestone_artifacts.description: Declared evidence artifacts for milestone sign-off (policy=milestone). A hook validates each artifact's presence and freshness by comparing captured_build_hash against the current build hash — reusing the traceability evidence freshness mechanism rather than inventing a second scheme.

milestone_signoff.description: Human sign-off on the milestone. SECURITY: S7 MUST require write_token authority to record this field — a subagent must not be able to sign off on its own work (see PACING-R-008).

slices.description: Ordered list of work slices tracked by this run.

schema_version.description: Schema version marking the sealed regime (S2). Absent on pre-sealed legacy ledgers. Written by cmdInit when the sealed regime is active.

version.description: Legacy schema version field used before the sealed regime (pre-S2). Superseded by schema_version. Accepted for backward compatibility with old ledgers on disk.

motive.description: Motive id (slug) this run is linked to. Written by `ledger init --motive <id>`.

motive_ref.description: Motive slug passed via init input JSON. Read by stop-gate to satisfy the plan-artifact requirement (alternative to motive).

rfc_ref.description: Legacy objective pointer read by journal-io.mjs as a fallback motive source. Informational; does not block session close.

session_ids.description: Multi-session id list read by motive-ground-truth.mjs (ledger.session_ids ?? [ledger.session_id]). Optional; normally derived from session_id.

scoped_tokens.description: Scoped tokens issued to junior-orchestrators via `ledger scope-token`. Each entry authorises the named scope to complete slices it created.

scope.description: Scope identifier (e.g. junior-orchestrator name or session label).

token.description: Opaque random token passed as --token to `ledger complete`.

advisorGate.description: Advisor verdict — either a bare verdict string or a rich object form.

citation.description: Evidence or source the advisor cited.

rubric.description: Rubric text used for the verdict.

milestoneArtifact.description: A named, hook-validatable evidence artifact declared for milestone verification. A hook can mechanically check: (1) that path/URL is reachable or exists on disk; (2) that captured_build_hash matches the current build hash (stale detection).

path.description: Local file path or URL pointing to the artifact (screenshot file, run-output log, live URL).

kind.description: Evidence category. 'screenshot' — image of running UI; 'run_output' — captured stdout/stderr of a command; 'live_url' — reachable HTTP endpoint; 'file' — any other deliverable file.

captured_build_hash.description: Opaque build/data hash recorded when the artifact was captured. A hook compares this against the current hash to detect staleness — reuses the same freshness mechanism as traceability-classify.mjs (ref.captured_build_hash vs current hash → 'fresh' | 'stale').

label.description: Human-readable label for the artifact (e.g. 'dashboard screenshot after regeneration'). Optional; aids human review during sign-off.

milestoneSignoff.description: Human sign-off record for a milestone. SECURITY: S7 MUST require write_token authority to write this object; recording it without the orchestrator token must be a hard error (exit 1). This prevents a subagent from signing off on its own work.

verdict.description: Human decision. APPROVE: pacing gate releases, session may proceed. REJECT: gate holds, remediation required.

verified_by.description: Identity of the human signer — typically a session_id or operator username. Recorded for audit. Must not be a subagent-supplied value when write_token is required.

verified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the sign-off, set by the CLI at write time.

artifacts_verified.description: Paths or URLs of artifacts the human reviewed and confirmed present and correct. Should be a subset of the paths declared in milestone_artifacts.

note.description: Optional human-written note — observations, caveats, or conditions on the APPROVE. Surfaced by the stop-gate when the milestone gate holds.

id.description: Unique slice identifier within the run (e.g. S1, STD6-A).

status.description: Current execution state of the slice.

wave.description: Wave number for fan-out ordering. May be absent on legacy slices.

kind.description: Work category. Absent slices default to 'impl' at runtime. 'fog' marks an open question with no acceptance criteria required.

question.description: The open question this fog slice is tracking. Only meaningful when kind is 'fog'.

blocked_by.description: Ids of slices that must complete before this one starts. Referential integrity is NOT enforced here.

acceptance.description: Observable acceptance criteria strings. Satisfaction is NOT evaluated by this schema.

ticket.description: Bare ticket id (e.g. 't1', 'my-ticket') — no path separators, no .md suffix. Path-shaped values like 'tickets/t1.md' are rejected.

created_by.description: Agent or scope identifier that created this slice (S4). Free-form string; distinct from session-scoped claimed_by.

covers_ac.description: AC coverage: string | string[] — which AC<n> labels this slice covers.

decisions.description: Decision ids constraining this slice (e.g. "D-40"). string | string[] — shape-only, no referential check.
